dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated cluster of small, solid, high-intensity pixel points along the lower lateral margin, lacking internal gradients and exhibiting higher spatial density towards the ventral edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship formed by a scalene triangle connecting the centroid of the central diamond-shaped annulus, the centroid of the irregular ring immediately ventral to it, and the centroid of the most distinct annulus in the posterior region.
